intro: MOV to MP4 converts your MOV videos into MP4. MOV is the format of iPhones, Macs and many cameras. It almost always carries H.264 or HEVC with AAC sound, which fit in MP4, so the change takes seconds and the picture stays exactly the same, but the file opens on Windows, Android and any editor.

First the tool checks which codecs the video carries. HEVC videos from iPhones are remuxed without touching the picture. If they had to be re-encoded, that would need HEVC decoding, which depends on a server setting: if it is not available, the page says so. When no re-encoding is needed, the conversion takes seconds even if the video lasts an hour, and the picture and sound are identical to the original.

When an MOV needs re-encoding to MP4, H.264 is used if the server has it enabled; otherwise AV1, a modern free codec that plays in browsers, Windows 10 and 11, Android and recent Macs and iPhones. The result note says which one was used. Global file metadata, such as the date, GPS location or the app that recorded it, is removed so you do not share more than you want.

Converting MOV to MP4 is part of the Pro plan: videos up to one hour and 1 GB, up to five at a time, with a ZIP of all of them at the end. They are processed on our server in the European Union and deleted automatically when they expire.
steps: Upload one or more MOV videos.
Press convert: it is copied or re-encoded depending on the codecs.
Download the MP4 or the ZIP with all of them.
